title: What If You Could Never Forget Anything?
description:
Every birthday, every conversation, every embarrassing thing you've ever said, remembered perfectly, forever. A few dozen people on Earth really live like this. Here's what a perfect memory would actually do to your life, the man who tried to burn his memories, why even super-memories can be fooled... and why forgetting might be the real superpower.

Would you take a perfect memory? Tell me in the comments 👇

▶ More What Ifs: What If You Could Hear Plants Scream?
